In fiscal 2022, Disney's streaming unit lost $3.4 billion.

Disney+ and Hulu (Entertainment DTC) operating results: -$3.42B (FY2022), -$2.50B (FY2023), +$143M (FY2024), +$1.33B (FY2025).
Disney+ ad-free: $6.99 at launch (2019), $21.49 from Oct 2026. A year of ad-free: $83.88 then, $257.88 now.
Q3 fiscal 2026 DTC operating income (new basis, excl. Hulu Live TV): $712M, vs $329M restated a year earlier.

Sources: Disney 10-K filings and earnings releases (FY2023-FY2026); Variety; CBS.
